comparison.objective: Candidate commissions a robot-axis shock absorber; pr-1209 clips a PCB lead flush while capturing and disposing of the hazardous offcut.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs recessed hex-key engagement, counterholding, collar adjustment, relocking, and impact testing. pr-1209 coordinates nipper placement/closure with the other gripper holding a small offcut, then transfers it to a cup.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe stopping cycles plus lock retention. pr-1209 requires a flush cut within 1.4 mm of the board, no unheld offcut flight beyond 10 cm, and released disposal in the cup for full score.
comparison.reason: Tool use and bimanual stabilization are shared generic primitives, but adjusting energy absorption is not the same tested ability as guarded cutting and offcut capture. Candidate lacks exact rebound, overload, tightening, and drift thresholds.
